name: weekly-performance
title: Weekly marketing performance
subtitle: Reported conversions and revenue. Channel attribution can overlap. Currencies remain separate.

sections.title: Performance
sections.sql: select campaign,workspace,currency,spend,conversions,revenue,cpa,roas,latest_day from campaign_performance order by workspace,campaign

sections.title: Spend pacing
sections.sql: select campaign,currency,budget,spend,expected_spend,pace_variance,remaining,remaining_daily_budget from campaign_pacing order by currency,campaign

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select issue,campaign,owner,currency,amount from attention order by issue,campaign

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by rule,item

sections.title: Claims to review
sections.sql: select x.id,c.name as campaign,x.statement,x.evidence,x.review_due,x.reviewed_by from claims x join campaigns c on c.id=x.campaign_id order by x.created_at,x.id

sections.title: Import history
sections.sql: select i.id,w.name as workspace,i.source,i.file_hash,i.row_count,i.actor,i.created_at from imports i join workspaces w on w.id=i.workspace_id order by i.created_at,i.id
